name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The User aims to quickly and easily find nearby recycling facilities based on their location or specific search criteria.
The User seeks to view detailed information about recycling facilities, including operational hours, accepted materials, and contact details.
The User desires to be informed about upcoming recycling events, special waste drop-off sites, and other relevant community initiatives.
The User wants to personalize their experience by saving favorite facilities, tracking their recycling activities, and receiving tailored recommendations.
The Administrator aims to maintain up-to-date and accurate information for all listed recycling facilities to provide reliable data to users.
The Administrator seeks to efficiently review, categorize, and respond to user feedback, complaints, and questions to improve the service.
The Administrator is responsible for implementing and enforcing security measures to protect user data and facility information from unauthorized access or breaches.
The Administrator aims to establish and maintain clear communication channels with recycling facility representatives to coordinate updates and address issues.
The Facility Representative aims to ensure that their facility's information, including operational hours and accepted materials, is always accurate and up-to-date on the platform.
The Facility Representative seeks to have a direct and efficient way to communicate any issues, concerns, or updates to the site administrators.
The Superuser aims to promptly update recycling center information to provide users with the most current and reliable data.
The Superuser seeks to efficiently answer user questions related to recycling centers, ensuring users receive helpful and correct information.
lowLevelGoals: The User can initiate a search for recycling facilities using their current GPS coordinates.
The User can input a specific address or zip code to find recycling facilities in that area.
The User can apply filters to narrow down search results based on the types of materials a facility accepts (e.g., plastic, paper, glass).
The User can see the locations of found recycling facilities displayed visually on an interactive map.
The User can access the specific opening and closing times for a chosen recycling facility.
The User can view a comprehensive list of all materials that a specific recycling facility accepts.
The User can find the phone number, email address, and official website for a chosen recycling facility.
The User can opt-in to receive alerts about future recycling events.
The User will get real-time alerts on their device about temporary special waste collection points.
The User will get email updates regarding local recycling programs and community efforts.
The User can mark a specific recycling facility to easily access it later.
The User can record an instance of recycling, including when it happened, what was recycled, and where.
The User can review all their previously recorded recycling actions.
The User will get suggestions for recycling facilities or events tailored to their previous recycling habits.
The Administrator can input all necessary details for a new recycling facility to be listed on the platform.
The Administrator can modify the opening and closing times of an already listed recycling facility.
The Administrator can add or remove materials that a specific recycling facility accepts.
The Administrator can remove a recycling facility's listing from the platform.
The Administrator can access and read all incoming feedback, complaints, and questions from users.
The Administrator can assign labels or types to user feedback for better organization and prioritization.
The Administrator can compose and send a reply to a specific user regarding their submission.
The Administrator can change the status of a feedback item to indicate that it has been handled.
The Administrator will ensure that all user-related data is encrypted both in transit and at rest.
The Administrator will set up permissions so that only authorized personnel can view or modify facility data.
The Administrator will schedule and perform routine checks to identify and fix potential security weaknesses.
The Administrator will create a dedicated, protected channel for representatives to interact with the platform.
The Administrator can send a single message to multiple facility representatives simultaneously.
The Administrator can get private messages or questions from individual facility representatives.
The Facility Representative can log into a specific interface to change their facility's opening and closing times.
The Facility Representative can modify the types of materials their facility accepts through the platform.
The Facility Representative can send a request to change their facility's phone number, email, or website.
The Facility Representative can compose and send a private message to the platform administrators.
The Facility Representative will get alerts or messages sent by the platform administrators.
The Superuser can review and decide whether to accept or decline changes submitted for recycling center details.
The Superuser can modify the opening and closing times for any listed recycling center without requiring prior approval.
The Superuser can modify the list of materials accepted by any recycling center without requiring prior approval.
The Superuser can view a list of all user inquiries that have not yet received a response.
The Superuser can write and send a response to a specific user inquiry.
The Superuser can change the status of a user question to indicate that a response has been provided.
